title: Jonathan Haidt: The moral roots of liberals and conservatives
summary: Psychologist Jonathan Haidt presents his moral foundations research in a TED talk. He argues that liberals and conservatives weigh a different set of moral values, which helps explain political divides.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible way to understand why people across the political spectrum disagree and to better understand opposing views.

quote.text: Jonathon Haidt has actually done some great scientific work on the real differences between liberals and conservatives.
